plan: 0.0 to 2.0 s (after the sting on the wide cut): the song clip full frame with its own sound at full level, no words on screen
2.0 s: he starts talking over it; the picture splits (clip and his face); the song's own sound eases down over 1.5 s to a steady background level under his voice, never keyed to his voice
about 0:16: the second clip (the wedding toast) carries the same song, still in the background
about 0:20, after the question: the song fades out over 2 s as the licensed bed (NO CURVES, instrumental) takes over at its bed level, so two pieces of music never play at once
the close: the song's own sound comes back under his last line and plays out the end
